# Attribution and source scope

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`) prepared the shared residual trace, binary
preparations, serialized leaf interface, stream lowering and checks with
substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work uses Apache-2.0.
Independent human review and formalization remain open.

We credit OpenAI's retained framework and Douglas Colkitt for the stream,
interchange and tape contracts. The selected word/hosting lineage includes
DreamingOfClouds' PR589 tuning on eumemic's PR555 word, Dugongue's PR541/548,
rohanarun's PR542, eumemic's PR490 whole-owner argument and alephnan's PR1627
literal reader and chronological hosting proof.

The source527 contributors supplied the normal forms and weighted leaf
factorization. commdata2338 supplied PR2160's selected good form, PR2188's
mixed descriptor grammar, PR1379's parking boundary and PR2332's selected
table/global-slot binding. Ross Richardson supplied PR2159's full-ring
fallback topology and covariance. Jose Manuel's PR2171/2195/2207/2234 and
PR2310/2364/2405 supply the controlled streams, raw-field grammar, completed
leaf sequence, uniform-control allowance and canonical-prefix interface.
We do not claim new versions of those algebraic identities or the earlier
opaque-child composition theorem.

We vendor seven necessary files from Jose Manuel's PR2449 at
`ef4640fbf9c360ef66dbc5d29916e741d515bf39`. Four remain byte-identical.
We adapt the controller for fallback and frozen-only leaf contexts, adjust
the source root path, and add a finite one-bit-suffix branch to the stream
copy routine. SOURCES.json records the original blobs/hashes and adaptations.
We retain the original source comments. The separate oracle remains checker
code; runtime numerical values stay encoded.

Concurrent contributions retain separate credit. ywz65's
[PR2473](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2473) audits
PR2449's local ADD invoice under its callback tariff. That audit does not
cover this new implementation or its suffix branch. We do not adopt its
numerical constant. The same author's
[PR2475](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2475) supplies
conditional whole-call owner-packet staging. Ross Richardson's
[PR2448](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2448) supplies

We claim no new multiplication exponent, selected-frontier change, full
